They couldn't get through the door. So they opened the ROOF. 🏠 Mark 2

The house in Capernaum was so packed there was “no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door.” So four friends “uncovered the roof” and let their friend down on his bed. “When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.” Then: “Arise, and take up thy bed.” (Mark 2:2-11)

A baby in a basket, on the river Pharaoh wanted him to die in. 🌊 Exodus 2

Pharaoh ordered: “Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river.” (Exodus 1:22) Moses' mother “took for him an ark of bulrushes” and laid it by the river. Pharaoh's own daughter found him and “had compassion on him.” And she paid his real mother to nurse him. (Exodus 2:3-9)

What's a time God turned something around for you? 👇

Before you hit checkout this Black Friday: peace isn't in your cart (John 14:27), content is a flex (Hebrews 13:5), store up what lasts (Matthew 6:20), and grace was never on sale, it's a gift (Romans 6:23).

The rich gave a lot. She gave two tiny coins. Jesus said she gave MORE. 🪙 Mark 12

Jesus “sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.” Then “a certain poor widow” threw in two mites. His verdict: “This poor widow hath cast more in, than all they… she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.” (Mark 12:41-44)

On the biggest shopping day of the year: what does giving “all” look like for you? 👇

Beaten. Chained. Midnight. And they started SINGING. 🎶 Acts 16

“At midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them. And suddenly there was a great earthquake… and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.” The jailer asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?” “Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved.” (Acts 16:25-31)

What's your midnight worship song? 👇
